programs.desc: A tech job leads newlyweds and their dogs to London; having previously moved from Denver to Seattle for his spouse, one dreams of a place with traditional English charm, but his more practical husband prefers something that isn't old and creaky.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: Hoping to up her tennis game, a California high schooler enrolls in an elite academy and relocates to Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur, France; volleying between her and her mom's competing needs might be their toughest competition yet.

programs.title: Home Town

programs.desc: Ben and Erin help their best friends turn a dilapidated 1930s department store into Laurel's first boutique hotel; with crushing financial risks and six months to open, they must finish a prototype room to secure bookings.

programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together
programs.desc: Ben and Erin help their friends open the first public retail space in the hotel, Scotsman Company; tensions rise as money's tight with a big loan delayed, but a newly discovered space offers hope if they can agree on how to use it.

programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together
programs.desc: Although the friends insist on no restaurants, the group finds a way to integrate a food concept into the hotel with the help of a local expert to curate a uniquely Southern experience; a new lounge space is revealed for guests, events and revenue.

programs.title: Home Town: Inn This Together
programs.desc: It's a race to finish the hotel; with rooms, an elevator, and the lobby still unfinished, a last-minute disaster threatens the hotel's holiday opening, as well as crucial bookings; and at last, the hotel gets its name.

programs.desc: New teams meet their mentors and take on the biggest beach homes yet, starting with the living room; before they can get to work, they must compete in the first challenge of the season to choose their house; the Kalamas join to judge.

programs.title: Renovation Aloha
programs.desc: The Kalamas purchase a fixer-upper in their Kailua hometown, aiming to help a family under a time crunch; the house is in an ideal location, but when permitting issues arise, the duo must find creative ways to keep the renovation on track.

programs.title: Renovation Aloha
programs.desc: In the second phase of their ambitious renovation, Kamohai and Tristyn tackle the remaining three units of their Kalama Street compound; they're hoping for a value high enough to keep the property in the family.
